title: Derive tumor regions
description: Writes a new segmentation set with the tumor core, the rim (tumor minus core) and a peritumoral band, measured in millimetres on each scan's own voxel grid. The whole tumor stays in the source set.

regions.title: Regions
regions.x-help: core, rim (tumor minus core) and peri (the peritumoral band)

tumor_label.title: Tumor label
tumor_label.x-help: Label name in the project label map; all its lesions in a scan form one tumor

organ_label.title: Organ label
organ_label.x-help: The peritumoral band keeps only this label's voxels; empty keeps every voxel

core_mm.title: Core erosion
core_mm.x-help: Core = tumor voxels farther than this from the tumor boundary

peri_inner_mm.title: Peritumoral band start
peri_inner_mm.x-help: The band starts beyond this distance from the tumor

peri_outer_mm.title: Peritumoral band end
peri_outer_mm.x-help: The band ends at this distance from the tumor (included); must be larger than the start

min_voxels.title: Minimum voxels
min_voxels.x-help: A region with fewer voxels is flagged too small in the QC; it is still written

seg_id.title: Segmentation set name
seg_id.x-help: Optional: lower-case letters, digits, - or _. Empty uses regions-<run>.
